name: 59 - DB - Add Clinical Intake and Triage

parameters.query:
DO $$
DECLARE
    constraint_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    IF TO_REGCLASS('public.human_handoff_tasks') IS NOT NULL THEN
        FOR constraint_record IN
            SELECT constraint_name
            FROM information_schema.table_constraints
            WHERE table_schema = 'public'
              AND table_name = 'human_handoff_tasks'
              AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'
        LOOP
            IF EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM pg_constraint constraint_item
                INNER JOIN pg_class relation
                    ON relation.oid = constraint_item.conrelid
                WHERE relation.relname = 'human_handoff_tasks'
                  AND constraint_item.conname =
                      constraint_record.constraint_name
                  AND (
                        pg_get_constraintdef(
                            constraint_item.oid
                        ) ILIKE '%source_type%'
                        OR
                        pg_get_constraintdef(
                            constraint_item.oid
                        ) ILIKE '%task_type%'
                      )
            ) THEN
                EXECUTE FORMAT(
                    'ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks DROP CONSTRAINT %I',
                    constraint_record.constraint_name
                );
            END IF;
        END LOOP;

        ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
            ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_source_type_check
            CHECK (
                source_type IN (
                    'appointment_confirmation',
                    'disruption_case',
                    'waitlist_offer',
                    'appointment',
                    'medication_case',
                    'insurance_case',
                    'feedback_case',
                    'knowledge_query',
                    'conversation_message',
                    'clinical_intake',
                    'manual'
                )
            );

        ALTER TABLE human_handoff_tasks
            ADD CONSTRAINT human_handoff_tasks_task_type_check
            CHECK (
                task_type IN (
                    'confirmation_no_response',
                    'reschedule_request',
                    'calendar_sync_issue',
                    'medical_review',
                    'complaint',
                    'insurance_support',
                    'information_request',
                    'conversation_handoff',
                    'clinical_triage',
                    'manual_followup'
                )
            );
    END IF;
END
$$;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinical_intake_cases (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    patient_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES patients(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    appointment_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES appointments(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    service_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES services(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    contact_mobile TEXT NOT NULL,

    source_channel TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web'
        CHECK (
            source_channel IN (
                'web',
                'whatsapp',
                'sms',
                'phone',
                'telegram',
                'manual',
                'api'
            )
        ),

    request_goal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'doctor_question'
        CHECK (
            request_goal IN (
                'service_selection',
                'urgency_guidance',
                'appointment_guidance',
                'pre_visit_question',
                'doctor_question',
                'other'
            )
        ),

    symptom_category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',
    chief_complaint TEXT NOT NULL,
    duration_text TEXT,

    severity INTEGER
        CHECK (
            severity IS NULL
            OR (
                severity >= 0
                AND severity <= 10
            )
        ),

    age_group TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown'
        CHECK (
            age_group IN (
                'child',
                'adolescent',
                'adult',
                'older_adult',
                'unknown'
            )
        ),

    pregnancy_possible BOOLEAN,
    is_worsening BOOLEAN,

    difficulty_breathing BOOLEAN,
    chest_pain BOOLEAN,
    loss_of_consciousness BOOLEAN,
    seizure BOOLEAN,
    severe_bleeding BOOLEAN,
    possible_overdose BOOLEAN,
    pregnancy_emergency_concern BOOLEAN,
    self_harm_or_violence BOOLEAN,

    chronic_conditions TEXT,
    current_medications TEXT,

    risk_level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'low'
        CHECK (
            risk_level IN (
                'low',
                'medium',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    recommended_route TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'routine_appointment'
        CHECK (
            recommended_route IN (
                'emergency_services',
                'urgent_clinic',
                'doctor_review',
                'routine_appointment',
                'general_information'
            )
        ),

    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'collecting_information'
        CHECK (
            status IN (
                'collecting_information',
                'awaiting_patient',
                'escalated',
                'routed',
                'under_review',
                'resolved',
                'closed'
            )
        ),

    consent_to_contact BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    consent_to_store_health_information BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    disclaimer_acknowledged BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    handoff_task_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES human_handoff_tasks(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    assigned_to TEXT,
    response_to_patient TEXT,
    resolution_note TEXT,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    resolved_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinical_intake_question_templates (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    clinic_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinics(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    symptom_category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general',

    question_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    question_text_fa TEXT NOT NULL,
    question_text_en TEXT,
    question_text_ar TEXT,

    answer_type TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (
            answer_type IN (
                'boolean',
                'number',
                'text',
                'select',
                'multiselect'
            )
        ),

    options_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::JSONB,

    required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    maps_to_case_field TEXT,

    risk_if_true TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none'
        CHECK (
            risk_if_true IN (
                'none',
                'high',
                'urgent'
            )
        ),

    active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,

    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_clinical_question_template
    ON clinical_intake_question_templates(
        COALESCE(clinic_id, 0),
        LOWER(symptom_category),
        question_code
    );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clinical_intake_answers (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,

    case_id BIGINT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES clinical_intake_cases(id)
        ON DELETE CASCADE,

    question_template_id BIGINT
        REFERENCES clinical_intake_question_templates(id)
        ON DELETE SET NULL,

    question_code TEXT NOT NULL,
    answer_text TEXT,
    answer_json JSONB,

    answered_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),

    UNIQUE (
        case_id,
        question_code
    )
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clinical_intake_open_cases
    ON clinical_intake_cases(
        clinic_id,
        status,
        risk_level,
        created_at DESC
    )
    WHERE status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clinical_intake_mobile
    ON clinical_intake_cases(
        clinic_id,
        contact_mobile,
        created_at DESC
    );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_clinical_intake_answers_case
    ON clinical_intake_answers(
        case_id,
        answered_at
    );

## فقط یک‌بار اجرا شود

این Migration سه جدول ایجاد می‌کند:

- `clinical_intake_cases`
- `clinical_intake_question_templates`
- `clinical_intake_answers`

قالب‌های اولیه عمومی و چند دسته تخصصی نیز ثبت می‌شوند.

این بخش برای جمع‌آوری ساختاریافته اطلاعات و ارجاع ایمن است؛ نه تشخیص یا درمان خودکار.
